description: A Python source file implementing a base class and utility functions for a Jinja-based code generator used in Chromium's Blink project, including template rendering, include normalization, and environment setup.

classes.name: CodeGeneratorBase
classes.description: Base class for jinja-powered code template generation, managing environment setup, template rendering, and code generation workflow.

methods.name: should_generate_code
methods.description: Determines if code should be generated based on provided definitions.

methods.name: set_global_type_info
methods.description: Sets global type information for IDL types based on the info provider.

methods.name: render_template
methods.description: Renders header and C++ templates with the given context and include paths.

methods.name: generate_code
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses for generating code from definitions.
